reason: A macOS menu bar and floating desktop companion that visualizes DeepSeek Harness agent session states through a configurable animated status ball.

summaries.zh: 一款 macOS 菜单栏伴侣应用，通过可拖动的悬浮状态球实时展示 DeepSeek Harness Agent 的会话状态。
summaries.en: A macOS menu bar companion that uses a movable floating status ball to display DeepSeek Harness agent session states in real time.

capabilities: Subscribes to DeepSeek Harness agent session events
Exposes an agent status interface for the desktop app
Displays and updates a floating macOS status indicator
Connects to a configured local or remote API endpoint
Checks GitHub Releases for application updates
